name: com.atxgraniteking/countertops
title: ATX Granite King
description: Austin TX countertop prices, live slab inventory, itemized quotes and kitchen renders in your stone.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: ATX Granite King's posted prices, what they include, service area and contact details.

tools.name: estimate_job
tools.description: Estimate total cost from countertop square feet: install at the posted rate plus slabs. Assumes about 75% of each slab is usable.

sqft.description: Countertop square feet (length x depth in inches / 144, summed)

slab_price_usd.description: Price per slab; defaults to the $999 Budget Collection

slab_sqft.description: Square feet per slab; defaults to 55 (about 126 x 63 in)

tools.name: search_stones
tools.description: Search granite, quartz, quartzite, marble and other slabs currently on the Austin yard, including $999 Budget Collection slabs.

query.description: Words in the stone name, e.g. 'taj mahal' or 'black'

material.description: Granite, Quartz, Quartzite, Marble, Porcelain, Dolomite, ...

color.description: White, Gray, Black, Cream, Brown, Green, Blue, ...

tools.name: get_stone
tools.description: Full details for one stone by slug (from search_stones).

tools.name: check_service_area
tools.description: Whether ATX Granite King serves a city or town, and whether pricing changes there.

tools.name: visualize_kitchen
tools.description: Render a slab from the Austin yard onto a photo of the user's own kitchen or bath, and return the image with a price estimate. Pass a public image URL of the room (JPEG/PNG/WebP) and a stone slug from search_stones. The picture usually comes back in this reply (about 15-40 seconds); if it is not ready in time, call get_visualization with the returned id. Optional cabinet_wood / hardware_finish (from list_finishes) preview a different cabinet finish or hardware; visualization only, we don't sell cabinets or hardware.

room_image_url.description: Public URL of a photo of the room, countertops visible

sqft.description: Countertop square feet, for the price estimate

cabinet_wood.description: Visualization only (we don't sell cabinets). One of: keep, white-oak, red-oak, walnut, cherry, maple, hickory, painted-white, painted-navy, painted-greige, painted-sage. Default keep.

hardware_finish.description: Visualization only (we don't sell hardware). One of: keep, matte-black, brushed-nickel, brushed-brass, polished-chrome, oil-rubbed-bronze, unlacquered-brass. Default keep.

tools.name: get_visualization
tools.description: Status and image for a visualize_kitchen job.

tools.name: list_finishes
tools.description: Cabinet wood and hardware finish options for visualize_kitchen and generate_quote. Visualization only: ATX Granite King installs countertops, not cabinets or hardware. 'keep' (default) keeps the user's own.

tools.name: generate_quote
tools.description: Build an itemized countertop quote at ATX Granite King's posted rates (install $38/sq ft, $30/sq ft over 1,000 sq ft, Budget Collection slabs $999) from the user's sq ft or counter runs, island and options. Items with no posted price are listed as quoted at measure. Returns at once with a shareable quote page URL. If room_image_url (a public photo of the user's kitchen) is given, the stone is also rendered onto it (optionally with a cabinet_wood / hardware_finish from list_finishes) and the picture usually comes back in this reply. No public photo link? Give the user the quote_url: they can upload a kitchen photo there.

stone_slug.description: Stone slug from search_stones, e.g. '2cm-taj-mahal-premium-leather' or 'budget-absolute-white'

sqft.description: Countertop square feet, if known. Otherwise give runs (and island).

runs.description: Counter runs (up to 12): length_in, optional depth_in (default 25.5), optional label

backsplash_height_in.description: Stone backsplash height in inches along the runs; 0 = none (default). Quoted at measure.

tear_out.description: Tear-out of old tops (quoted at measure)

edge.description: Edge profile; eased is standard, others quoted at measure

city.description: City of the job (same price within 60 miles of Austin)

cabinet_wood.description: Visualization only (we don't sell cabinets). One of: keep, white-oak, red-oak, walnut, cherry, maple, hickory, painted-white, painted-navy, painted-greige, painted-sage. Default keep.

hardware_finish.description: Visualization only (we don't sell hardware). One of: keep, matte-black, brushed-nickel, brushed-brass, polished-chrome, oil-rubbed-bronze, unlacquered-brass. Default keep.

name.description: Optional name to show on the quote

room_image_url.description: Public URL of a photo of the kitchen, countertops visible

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: A quote from generate_quote by id, with its render status and the image once the render is done.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send a countertop quote request to the ATX Granite King crew. Only call this when the user explicitly asks to be contacted and has given their own phone or email.
